english_classification.chapter_title: The Chapter of the Nazorean who questions the Teacher
english_classification.chapter_note: This chapter contains NO cosmological-correspondential substrate. Teaching purity is 0.000. The entire chapter is an apologetic narrative: a Nazorean asks whether God is good or evil, and Mani argues via civic judge analogy that God is a judge who limits evil without being evil himself. The argument works through analogy from contemporary civic life to theology — no cosmic domain-to-domain mapping exists. Contains an explicit Gospel citation (¶10: Matt 6:21/Luke 12:34). The chapter is entirely composed of dialogue frame, editorial theological argument, and exhortation. It represents Manichaean apologetic composition, not a wrapper around older teaching.
